name: Billboard Sphere Projection
aliases: Billboard Sphere Projection — Spherical Contribution Factor Rendering
Billboard Sphere Rendering with Depth Offset
definition: A technique to render a 3D sphere as a 2D billboard by calculating a spherical contribution factor based on the fragment's distance from the center.
summary: Billboard Sphere Projection renders 3D volumetric points as 2D billboards that simulate spherical geometry and depth via fragment shader calculations, avoiding expensive ray-marching or pre-sorted depth buffers.
